journal_lines: The passage opened into something vast and paper-smelling. Cannot read. Brought back a page anyway.
A library underground. Old shelves. Most of it rotted. Some of it wasn't.
Rows and rows of books in a sealed chamber. Took one that seemed different. Left the rest.
The smell of old paper in a stone corridor. Found the source eventually.
The books were arranged. By what system, unclear. Took one from the middle.
Shelves reaching ceiling in every direction. Most of it ruined. Not all.
A library that has not been opened in a very long time. Opened it.
The pages I could read said very little I understood. The one I couldn't, I took.
Returned with one intact volume. Cannot read it. Felt it was important anyway.
The stronghold smell is stone and rot and old paper. The paper section was here.
Books behind cobwebs behind a sealed door. All of it eventually accessed.
The librarian, whoever they were, did not come back. The books waited.
